baseline_models.focus_anchor: The noun-adjective unit جَنَّةٍ عَالِيَةٍ joins the focus roots ج ن ن and ع ل و.
baseline_models.mechanism: A tree-covered orchard is located or built high; concealment by vegetation and vertical elevation remain concrete properties of one place.

activation_trace.role: The tree-covered garden image supplies the concrete orchard and its enclosing vegetation.
Physical rising and height place that orchard above an ordinary level.

changed_reading.before: The phrase names a garden with an unspecified positive adjective.
changed_reading.after: It names a vegetation-covered orchard whose elevation is a concrete spatial feature.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: جَنَّةٍ can activate protection while عَالِيَةٍ can activate noble rank.
baseline_models.mechanism: The garden functions as a shielded enclosure and its height as conferred standing, so place and status coexist as an honored refuge.

activation_trace.role: The protective-cover image makes the garden an enclosure that shelters its occupant.
Nobility and high rank make elevation social and evaluative as well as spatial.

changed_reading.before: High describes only the garden's altitude.
changed_reading.after: The phrase can describe a protected place that is simultaneously an honored high station.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The botanical branch of جَنَّةٍ and the rising branch of عَالِيَةٍ meet inside the focus phrase.
baseline_models.mechanism: Height may characterize the garden's own vigorous, interlaced growth: a rising canopy rather than merely terrain beneath it.

activation_trace.role: Thick, tall, intertwined growth supplies a living canopy with upward force.
Rising and being high turns the growth itself into the bearer of elevation.

changed_reading.before: The garden sits on a high site.
changed_reading.after: The garden may itself rise as dense, tall growth, making height an ecological property.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The concealment branch of جَنَّةٍ can combine with the haughty-domination branch of عَالِيَةٍ before context disciplines the pairing.
baseline_models.mechanism: Focus-only, an elevated enclosure could momentarily suggest insulated superiority: power raised above others and hidden behind its boundary.

activation_trace.role: Covering and concealment supplies the possibility of an insulated enclosure.
Haughty domination supplies an initially live but morally ambivalent kind of elevation.

changed_reading.before: Every positive sense of highness is assumed in advance.
changed_reading.after: Without context, highness also leaves a weak possibility of enclosed, domineering superiority.

context_deltas.mechanism: The elevated station is not free-floating prestige. A judgment-bearing record, its blessed right-hand reception, and reckoning make the height look publicly ratified and allocated.

activation_trace.role: Noble rank supplies the focus-side status that the preceding procedure can confer.
Protective enclosure makes the conferred station a secure placement, not only a title.
A written fixing that entails judgment turns the book into the formal basis of the new station.
Blessing in the right-hand cue marks the award as favorable before the focus names its height.
Counting and accounting supplies the adjudicative process linking record to elevation.

structural_cues: The right-hand book and first-person accounting statement immediately precede the satisfied life and high garden.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies record, favorable hand, accounting, and noble-rank images; I infer that the procedure confers the rank. A live alternative is that these are adjacent signs of reward without a procedural causal arrow.

changed_reading.before: The protected high station is simply present.
changed_reading.after: The protected high station is a publicly accounted-for placement conferred after the record is opened.

context_deltas.mechanism: The hidden-heart potential of جَنَّةٍ is externalized: an inward certainty about encountering reckoning becomes a surrounding garden once the anticipated encounter occurs.

activation_trace.role: The hidden heart or inner matter supplies an interior state that can be spatially realized.
The tree-covered garden supplies the external environment into which that inner state opens.
Certainty reached through a sign makes the speaker's prior expectation more than a passing guess.
What a person encounters of good or evil supplies realization of the expected meeting.
Accounting specifies the object of certainty whose realization precedes the garden.

structural_cues: The speaker's retrospective statement in 69:20 is followed by his present state in 69:21-22.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies inward certainty, encounter, accounting, and a hidden-inner branch for the focus noun; I infer an inside-to-outside realization. The alternative is that the speech only explains confidence and does not shape the garden image.

changed_reading.before: The garden is solely an external destination.
changed_reading.after: The garden can also be read as the outward environment corresponding to a previously hidden certainty.

context_deltas.mechanism: The next ayah reverses the ordinary effect of elevation. The garden rises, yet its pickable clusters approach; height produces an overhead canopy that comes within reach rather than remoteness.

activation_trace.role: Tall, intertwined growth supplies the rising canopy from which fruit can hang.
Physical height establishes the distance that the next ayah unexpectedly cancels.
The picked fruit and near cluster give the elevated growth a reachable yield.
The upper drawing toward the middle supplies the downward accommodation that resolves high with near.

structural_cues: The immediately adjacent feminine descriptors عالية and دانية form a high-near reversal across 69:22-23.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies high growth, near clusters, and an upper-to-middle motion image; I infer a canopy bending provision toward the resident. The alternative is simple coexistence of a high location and independently reachable fruit.

changed_reading.before: A high garden is expected to place desirable things farther away.
changed_reading.after: Its height is hospitable architecture: what grows above is brought near enough to take.

context_deltas.mechanism: Two economies emerge. What was advanced matures into effortless, edible growth in the garden, while accumulated property on the opposite path proves unable to suffice.

activation_trace.role: Vigorous growth makes the garden a productive medium rather than inert scenery.
The yield of trees and crops identifies the garden's growth as usable return.
Ease without hardship marks the return as freely enjoyed rather than anxiously guarded.
Advanced capital supplies the temporal logic of something sent ahead and later realized.
Sufficiency names the function that the condemned speaker's wealth fails to perform.
Accumulating property supplies the inert counter-economy that cannot become saving provision.

structural_cues: The causal بما أسلفتم follows the garden's fruit, while ما أغنى عني ماليه voices the opposite outcome.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies prior advance, botanical yield, effortless enjoyment, failed sufficiency, and accumulated property; I infer maturation into living return. The alternative is a non-economic reward relation with no investment analogy.

changed_reading.before: The high garden is a luxurious possession.
changed_reading.after: It is living return: what was sent ahead becomes consumable provision, unlike property that merely remained owned.

context_deltas.mechanism: The passage contrasts two modes of containment. The successful person is inside a shielding garden; the other is seized, limb-bound, exposed to fire, and forced inside a chain.

activation_trace.role: A protective cover makes being inside the garden sheltering rather than restrictive.
The upper side positions protected containment opposite the later downward punitive trajectory.
Seizure and captivity remove agency at the entrance to punitive containment.
A collar binding the limb supplies constriction as the inverse of the garden's cover.
Meeting the fire and its heat supplies exposure where the garden had supplied protection.
Insertion of one thing into another supplies the forced punitive counterpart to dwelling in the garden.

structural_cues: The preposition في frames both في جنة in 69:22 and في سلسلة in 69:32, but the latter is governed by seizure and imperatives.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies protective covering, capture, binding, fire exposure, and forced insertion; I infer that the repeated inside relation is an intentional reversal. The alternative is that the two locatives are unrelated descriptions of reward and punishment.

changed_reading.before: The garden is simply an enclosed destination.
changed_reading.after: Its enclosure is freedom-giving protection, sharply opposed to the coercive inside of collar, fire, and chain.

context_deltas.mechanism: The physical high-near reversal acquires an ethical analogue. Noble elevation bends its produce toward need, while the condemned path is defined by failure even to urge provision for one whose subsistence or station is constrained.

activation_trace.role: Noble rank supplies the kind of elevation whose moral behavior is being tested.
Abundant growth supplies provision capable of moving from height toward a recipient.
Near fruit clusters make abundance available rather than merely displayed above.
The upper drawing toward the middle gives elevation a downward, accommodating motion.
Urging toward an act supplies the explicitly missing social motion toward feeding.
Feeding another turns available produce into a social relation rather than private consumption.
Subsistence that stabilizes one's station identifies what provision does for the deprived recipient.

structural_cues: Near fruit and the invitation to eat in 69:23-24 contrast with the explicit failure to urge feeding in 69:34.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies noble height, descending availability, feeding, exhortation, and stabilizing subsistence; I infer an ethical analogy in which true elevation makes provision descend. The alternative is that near fruit concerns only the rewarded individual's convenience.

changed_reading.before: Highness marks privileged separation above need.
changed_reading.after: Highness is pictured as abundance that bends near and, by contrast, exposes the failure to move food toward need.

context_deltas.mechanism: Context weakens the focus-only suspicion of insulated domination. The positive state is marked by blessing and satisfaction, while possessed authority belongs to the opposite speaker and perishes.

activation_trace.role: Haughty domination preserves the ambivalent focus-only hypothesis that context will test.
Noble rank supplies the non-coercive alternative that becomes stronger in context.
Blessing marks the positive path's elevation as favorable rather than predatory.
Satisfaction opposed to anger gives the high state an affective register without domination.
Falling into ruin removes the opposite speaker's claimed basis of superiority.
Power and authority locate coercive standing on the path where it collapses, not in the garden.

structural_cues: The blessed, satisfied right-hand scene is mirrored by the left-hand speaker's declaration that his authority has vanished.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies blessing and satisfaction on one path and failed authority on the other; I infer that عالية favors bestowed honor over domination. The alternative remains that the lost authority was neutral capacity, so the haughty branch is weakened rather than erased.

changed_reading.before: The high enclosure may suggest insulated domination.
changed_reading.after: Context makes honored, satisfied elevation much more plausible and leaves domineering superiority only as a faint contrastive shadow.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it composes separate right, left, and upper branch images into a passage-wide body map. It remains anchored in عَالِيَةٍ and the mirrored hand assignments, but downstream prose should present it only as an exploratory spatial analogy, not as the lexical meaning of the phrase.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: عَالِيَةٍ can denote the upper side, while the two destinies are assigned to right and left hands.

activation_trace.role: The upper side supplies the vertical pole of an embodied spatial map.
The right hand and rightward direction place the successful destiny on one bodily side.
The left direction opposed to the right places the failed destiny on the other bodily side.

changed_reading.before: High is an isolated altitude word.
changed_reading.after: High may be the upper coordinate in a body-scaled moral topology organized by right and left destinies.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it uses the branch-distant fetus, fresh-beginning, and postpartum-recovery images against later death and ruin language. It remains anchored in branches of both focus roots and the post-account destiny sequence, but it should be rendered only as a generative rebirth analogy, never as a direct gloss of جنة عالية.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: جَنَّةٍ carries hidden-fetus and fresh-beginning branches, while عَالِيَةٍ carries a specialized recovery branch.

activation_trace.role: The fetus hidden in the womb supplies a protected interval before emergence.
Fresh beginning supplies renewal rather than mere continuation of the prior state.
Recovery from puerperium or illness supplies rising into a restored condition.
The effective decree of death supplies the terminal boundary across which renewal is imagined.
Falling into destruction on the opposite path sharpens renewal as a contrasted post-death possibility.

changed_reading.before: The garden is a completed reward after death.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, it can image protected gestation into a fresh, restored mode of life after the terminal boundary.

strongest_changes: The following دانية revises عالية: elevation bends its fruit toward the resident instead of producing distance.
The repeated relation of being inside contrasts a shielding garden with forced insertion into collar, fire, and chain.
Record, accounting, prior advance, and failed wealth make the garden both a ratified station and a living return rather than static luxury.
The later failure to urge feeding activates an ethical reading in which true elevation makes provision move downward toward need.
summary.what_was_special: The two-word focus sustained orchard, shield, rank, canopy, and an initially ambivalent superiority at once. Context sharpened these through high-near and shelter-confinement reversals without collapsing the coexisting physical, juridical, ecological, social, and inward readings; the body-axis and gestational readings remain deliberately contained outliers.
remaining_uncertainties: Whether عالية primarily marks physical altitude, noble rank, the garden's own tall canopy, or intentionally supports all three.
Whether the advance-and-return and elevation-that-feeds mechanisms are passage-level causal designs or productive analogies activated by nearby contrasts.
The embodied-axis and gestational-renewal readings depend on branch-distant composition and should remain exploratory.
